en.title: Hello, I'm June.
en.subtitle: About Marsk — who writes it, why it exists, and what slow living means here.
en.content:
Marsk started as a stack of paper notebooks and became a website when the stack fell over.

I write about the unspectacular: mending, baking, walking, waiting. The entries are short by intention and slow by nature. Nothing here is optimized, monetized or hurried.

By day I bind books in a small studio. By early morning — the only time that's really mine — I write this journal.
